# Experimental DWG2000 writer

The GPL-3.0-or-later LibreDWG `dxf2dwg` command is compiled to WebAssembly from
the same `mlightcad/libredwg-web` v0.8.4 corresponding source as the reader.
No C patch was applied. Emscripten3.1.69 and CMake3.31 were used. This separate
build is needed because the published reader interface exposes no encoder.

Run `bash vendor/dwg-writer/build.sh /path/to/libredwg-web-0.8.4`, then
`node build.cjs`. The corresponding source archive is included in the complete
0.9 source delivery and the prior [complete0.7 delivery](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SJnl4HztNggnzmd_pVEGWNP8ZyvfWRCW/view).
Upstream: https://github.com/mlightcad/libredwg-web/tree/v0.8.4 .
Byte-identical reproduction across SDK versions is not promised.

`dxf2dwg.cjs` is generated Emscripten glue. WASM is embedded as gzip/base64 in
the HTML; `node restore-vendor.cjs` restores it. `template.dxf` is a blank
document generated by `ezdxf.new('R2007').saveas(...)`, without user data.
`aci.json` is the existing MIT-licensed dxf-parser palette (THIRD_PARTY.md).
`cp1256.json` maps each byte to its Python `cp1256` Unicode code point.

`src/dwg-encoder.js` supplies complete DXF tables, model-space ownership,
handles, CP1256 layer names, Unicode text escapes and nearest ACI colors.
Straight polylines flatten to LINE segments; curved compounds export analytic
ARC centerlines and visible width faces. The upstream parser can issue
duplicate-handle warnings for template records. The application decodes the
output and compares supported geometry before allowing its download.
